Notes on keeping things simple

September 2, 2026 · Sample post

It’s easy to spend more time choosing tools than making the thing you wanted to make.

A useful question is: what would let me finish the first version today? For a personal website, that might mean a short introduction and a single post. The rest can wait until there’s a reason for it.

Leave room to change your mind

Small projects are easier to understand and easier to change. When everything fits in a few files, coming back after a month doesn’t require an afternoon of remembering how it all works.

I like that kind of simplicity. It leaves more time for the part I actually came to do.
